request.style: English, celtic, solo male voice with soft choir, Celtic harp, bodhran, fiddle, tin whistle, flute, melancholic and solemn, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Rafu
Sent by Moses from the Wilderness of Paran
One leader chosen from each ancestral line
To scout the land of Canaan, divine

[Chorus]
See what the land is like, strong or weak
Are their towns open camps or fortified peaks
Is the soil rich or poor, trees on it or not
Be bold and bring back the fruit, the lot

[Verse]
They went up from Zin as far as Rehob
Neared Lebo-hamath, tested the path
Forty days they traveled through the land
Then returned to the people, in the hand

[Chorus]
See what the land is like, strong or weak
Are their towns open camps or fortified peaks
Is the soil rich or poor, trees on it or not
Be bold and bring back the fruit, the lot

[Verse]
It truly does flow with milk and honey
But the people are strong, cities are large
We saw the descendants of Anak there
Amalekites in the Negev, the air
Hittites and Jebusites in the hills
Canaanites by the sea and the fields

[Bridge]
Caleb quieted the people before Moses
Said we should go up and take possession
But the others said we cannot attack
They are stronger than we are, weak and lack

[Chorus]
See what the land is like, strong or weak
Are their towns open camps or fortified peaks
Is the soil rich or poor, trees on it or not
Be bold and bring back the fruit, the lot

[Outro]
In our eyes we seemed like grasshoppers
So we seemed to them, the shadow of copers
